purpose: Compare two generation paths from exactly the same translated synthetic Japanese input, without editing translations or selecting retries.

criteria: thin sail visible from multiple views
cases.unscorable: absolute smallness without a scale reference

criteria: thin canopy has plausible front and back

cases.text: 長い注ぎ口が付いたじょうろ
criteria: long spout distinct and attached to body
holes/openings and thin parts not filled or broken

methods.label: SDXL Turbo → TripoSR
methods.startup: new image and reconstruction worker per request
methods.internalSuffix: . One complete isolated object centered on a plain gray background. Matte clay sculpture, three-quarter product view.

executionOrder: For each case in listed order: one description request, then Shap-E, then image-TripoSR. No concurrent GPU requests. Do not retry or hand-edit failed or semantically incorrect output.
failureHandling: Keep HTTP status, safe error response and elapsed time. If translation fails, mark both generators skipped. If generation fails, retain failure and continue next method/case.

rendering.normalization: shared SurfaceScene centers bounding box and scales longest side to 2.6
rendering.letters: 小さな帆船。開いた傘。長い注ぎ口が付いたじょうろ。
rendering.views: three identical camera views in grey and in the shared text surface material

assessment: After fixed generation, mark each criterion yes/partial/no/unassessable and cite saved views. Separate translation errors, object/part structure, back-side flattening, thin parts, holes and text coverage. No general success-rate claim from three examples or one seed.
timingCaveat: Record description time, generator HTTP time, API stage times, and the sum. Shap-E keeps weights loaded while image-TripoSR cold-starts; these are observed service latencies, not equalized algorithm benchmarks. Identical seed integers do not imply matched noise between different models.
provenance: Only the three synthetic descriptions above. Client explicitly saves returned generated GLBs into public/end-to-end-models. Services do not persist request text or generated artifacts. No reference images or user writing are used.
